lanes.name: public-data-requests
lanes.focus: Explicit fixed-price requests for small sourced public datasets and factual research; exclude job boards and bounty platforms.

lanes.name: niche-forums
lanes.focus: Public specialist forums: suppliers, business operations, software communities. A complaint without an explicit payment offer is not a lead.

lanes.name: reddit-requests
lanes.focus: Original buyer requests in niche communities. Check comments for filled/solved status. No direct scraping, no seller advertisements, no private-person research.

lanes.name: public-social-requests
lanes.focus: Public indexed posts only. Do not infer live access to X or private Facebook groups. Skip unavailable originals.
